title: Capability row 15 (end-to-end live headed-Chrome reconnect+gap proof) cites an uncommitted scratch script (offline_proof.py) as its evidence, so no future checker can re-run the falsification without rebuilding the proof from scratch
evidence: qa/manifests/t-029-reconnect.md row 15 'How it's falsified' column: 'offline_proof.py (scratch, not committed — see Evidence)'. The script and its fixture_server.py are described in prose under 'Offline live proof' but neither file exists in the repo (git show HEAD -- '*offline_proof*' '*fixture_server*' returns nothing). This checker's dispatch explicitly forbids running the live Chrome bot against a real meeting, so row 15 could not be independently re-verified and is recorded as UNVERIFIED-by-checker rather than silently accepted.
reproduction: git show HEAD --stat | grep -i offline_proof (no match); qa/manifests/t-029-reconnect.md row 15
fix_direction: Either commit a trimmed, CI-safe version of fixture_server.py/offline_proof.py under packages/meeting-bot/py/ (or a scratch/ dir the repo keeps) so the live-reload+gap proof is re-runnable, or downgrade row 15's claim to 'manually verified once, not repo-reproducible' so future checkers don't need to rebuild it from a prose description.
